{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'loyal' in customer_segment
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check the range and type of 'converted'
print("Values in converted:", df['converted'].unique())
print("Type of converted:", df['converted'].dtype)

# Check how many rows have customer_segment == 'loyal'
loyal_count = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'].shape[0]
print("Number of loyal customers:", loyal_count)"}
